Others.|Kli the Elder, ''Rammahgon''|''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]''}} '''Ossus''' was a terrestrial [[planet]] located in the [[Adega system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Auril sector]] that was affiliated with the [[Jedi Order]]. The planet was [[orbit]]ed by at least one [[Ossus's forest moon|forest moon]]. Some Jedi [[scholar]]s made the case that Ossus was the site of the Jedi Order's [[First Jedi Temple|first temple]]. According to the [[Qel-Droma Epics]], Ossus was a Jedi retreat and the largest repository of Jedi knowledge in history. At the very least, Ossus housed the [[Great Jedi Library]] and a [[First Temple|Jedi temple]]. In the Qel-Droma Epics, Ossus was decimated during the [[Cron Supernova]], when the [[Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow]] triggered [[star]]s in the [[Cron Cluster]] to become [[supernova]]e. The Jedi managed to [[Evacuation of Ossus|save]] a fraction of the artifacts housed on the planet, such as mosaic floors and the [[Chronicles of Med'eeth]], which made it to the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the planet [[Coruscant]] via nearby [[Exis Station]]. According to legend, what [[Jedi survivors (Ossus)|few Jedi]] survived the blast banded together to survive. Over millennia, those [[human]]s became tribal [[Ysanna]], a group of [[near-human]]s with a high percentage of [[Force-sensitive|Force-sensitivity]] among them, who regarded it as atavistic magic. The other humans on the planet were considered a minority population. During the [[New Republic Era]], [[Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker]] constructed his [[Jedi Temple of Luke Skywalker|Jedi temple]] on Ossus. There, he trained students until the [[Jedi temple|temple]] was [[Destruction of the Jedi Temple|destroyed]] in [[28 ABY]], after which he went into a self-imposed [[Exile (punishment)|exile]]. ==Description== [[File:Lightning_strikes_Ossus_NoP.png|thumb|left|250px|A lightning storm rages across the barren surface of Ossus]] Ossus was a terrestrial [[planet]][[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] located in the [[Adega system]] within the [[Auril sector]] of [[the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories]], positioned at coordinates R-6 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]], [[orbit]]ed by at least one [[Ossus's forest moon|forest moon]]. A wasteland at one point in its history, vicious lightning storms ravaged the surface of Ossus, although it was verdantPer the Audio Description for "[[Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger]]" available on [[Disney+]]. by the [[New Republic Era]]. It was home to [[kaddyr bug]]s and [[kirruk]]s, as well as [[Arges frog|Sorgan frogs]] and [[mud yak]]s. ==History== ===Early history=== [[File:Ossus-FDCR.png|thumb|right|250px|Ossus as depicted in the Qel-Droma Epics.]] According to the [[Qel-Droma Epics]], Ossus was a bulwark against [[Hutt]] and [[Sith]] aggression, a [[Jedi]] retreat, and the largest repository of Jedi knowledge in history. Certain [[scholar]]s surmised it was the location of the first [[Jedi temple]] ever built, although [[Ahch-To]], [[Coruscant]], [[Jedha]], and [[Tython]] were also candidates. The fabled planet was thought to have troves of [[holocron]]s and [[datacard]]s filled with Jedi wisdom from throughout the ages, and if one were to discover it, they could gain access to unmatched power. According to the Jedi, around [[12,000 BBY]],According to ''[[Nexus of Power]]'', Ossus had been the Jedi's cultural center for a 12,000-year period before the [[Imperial Era]]. Ossus became a cultural center of the [[Jedi Order]] and was made a near-mandatory pilgrimage site. Jedi operating along the [[Perlemian Trade Route]] were said to have gone to Ossus for unique opportunities to [[Jedi training|train]] under other [[Jedi Master]]s and contemplate a wider view of [[the Force]]. It was one of the worlds mentioned in a chapter of the ''[[Rammahgon]]'', an ancient [[Sacred Jedi texts|Jedi text]] written by the Jedi [[Kli the Elder]], alongside Jedha and [[Xenxiar]]. According to the Qel-Droma Epics, [[Odan-Urr]] received his Jedi training at the [[First Temple|Jedi Praxeum]] on Ossus under Jedi Master [[Ooroo]], and later, honoring a promise to his Master, he designed and oversaw the construction of the [[Great Jedi Library]] atop the [[Ooroo Canyon]]. Odan-Urr also commissioned the [[Knossa Branch Library]] in the Ossus [[city]] of [[Knossa]], for academics and Jedi who sought knowledge for [[time]]-sensitive investigations. The Great Library was destroyed at some point prior to the [[Clone Wars]]. At some point before the construction of the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the planet Coruscant, the Jedi [[Evacuation of Ossus|evacuated]] a few of the [[holobook]]s and artifacts from the lost Great Jedi Library on Ossus which made it to the [[Jedi Archives]] on Coruscant. At some point, the mosaic floor of the Ossus temple was salvaged and transported to the Order's newer headquarters on Coruscant. In the Qel-Droma Epics, Ossus was decimated during the [[Cron Supernova]] around [[4,000 BBY|4000 BBY]],According to ''[[Nexus of Power]]'', the [[Qel-Droma Epics]] dates the destruction of Ossus to approximately 4000 [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Imperial Era]]. when the [[Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow]] triggered [[star]]s in the [[Cron Cluster]] to become [[supernova]]e. The Jedi had little warning of the coming cataclysm and prioritized the artifacts from the [[Chamber of Antiquities]] of the Great Jedi Library. Despite the efforts, they only managed to save a fraction of the artifacts housed on the planet, which made it to the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant via nearby [[Exis Station]], leaving the Great Library in ruins. Prior to the establishment of the [[Jedi High Council]] on [[Coruscant]], a Jedi Council was located at Ossus.[[Star Wars Jedi Master Magazine 1|''Star Wars Jedi Master'' Magazine 1]] ===Galactic Republic=== As recently as [[122 BBY/Canon|122 BBY]],According to ''[[Nexus of Power]]'', the Jedi Order suggested they possessed artifacts from the [[Qel-Droma Epics]] as recently as a century before the [[Clone Wars]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the start of the Clone Wars to [[22 BBY]]. Therefore, the suggestion must have happened as recently as [[122 BBY/Canon|122 BBY]]. the Jedi Order suggested they possessed Ossus artifacts that were mentioned by name in the Qel-Droma Epics. At some point before the [[Reproduction|birth]] of the antiques dealer [[Antron Bach]], the last charred fragment of the [[Chronicles of Med'eeth]] was also salvaged from the ruins of the planet. At some point during or after the [[Clone Wars]], Ossus was part of a [[Ossus conspiracy theory|conspiracy theory]] which claimed [[Count]] [[Dooku]], the fallen Jedi who had publicly led the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]],{{Film|II}} had established a [[Separatist base (Ossus)|base]] there to search for lost artifacts. Another [[Ossus hyperspace route rumor|rumor]] swirled around the same time of a secret [[hyperspace route]] to Ossus and the Jedi possessing a hidden fortune there. ===New Republic Era=== ====The new temple==== {{Quote|What is this place?''"
"''There's nothing now, but will someday be a great school. Grogu will be its first student.|Din Djarin and Ahsoka Tano|}} [[File:ConstructionofSkywalkerSchool-BoBFCh6.png|thumb|left|250px|Ahsoka Tano and Din Djarin observed the early stages of the temple's construction.]] At some point, Jedi Master [[Luke Skywalker]] explored the subterranean ruins of Ossus and discovered the original ''Rammahgon'' text, which was thought to have been destroyed over five thousand [[Standard year|years]] beforehand.''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' Seeking to restore the Jedi Order after the [[Great Jedi Purge]] by training a new generation of Jedi in the ways of the Force,''[[Star Wars: The Secrets of the Jedi]]'' Skywalker constructed his [[Jedi Temple of Luke Skywalker|new Jedi temple and school]] on Ossus, which was at that point had no permanent population. Around [[9 ABY]],{{BoBFDate}} the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]] traveled to Ossus to see [[Din Grogu|Grogu]], a [[Force-sensitive]] [[foundling]] that he protected and ultimately returned to the Jedi. The temple was in the early stages of construction at the time, and Djarin observed multiple [[ant droid]]s in the process of building a dome-shaped structure. ====A new generation==== {{Quote|We were… learning. We all studied together. I was first, but they came not long after. Voe, Hennix and Tai.|Ben Solo|[[The Rise of Kylo Ren 3|''The Rise of Kylo Ren'' 3]]}} [[File:LukeTeachingJedi-TheRiseOfKyloRen3.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Skywalker would train nearly a dozen students at the temple.]] Between [[15 ABY]] and [[16 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' he took on several more students, including [[Hennix]], [[Tai]], and [[Voe]], and trained them and [[Ben Solo]] in the ways of the Force at his Jedi Temple. In his lessons on the nature of the Force, Skywalker described how the Force flowed everywhere and all things were equal in the Force. Though some like Solo would find it easier to let the Force flow through them, that did not make any being stronger than another. Skywalker taught them Jedi techniques and traditions such as [[telekinesis]], [[meditation]], and the use and construction of [[lightsaber]]s. As his first class of students grew older, newer younglings continued to be brought in and trained, with Skywalker being helped by Solo and the Twi'lek [[Enyo]] in such matters. ====Temple ablaze==== {{Quote|When I came to, the temple was burning. He had vanished with a handful of my students. And slaughtered the rest.|Luke Skywalker, to Rey|}} [[File:LukesTempleBurning-TLJ.jpg|thumb|left|220px|After regaining consciousness, Skywalker and R2-D2 stared at the destroyed temple in shock and shame.]] One night in [[28 ABY]], Skywalker's concerns for Solo had reached the point where he decided he must go to his nephew's [[Ben Solo's hut|room]] and confront him. While peering into the mind of his sleeping nephew, Skywalker sensed a growing darkness and the machinations of Snoke. Instinctively, Skywalker ignited [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber|his lightsaber]]. However, it was a fleeting moment and Skywalker was soon overcome by shame and regret. Waking to find his uncle standing over him with lightsaber drawn, Solo believed he meant to kill him and fought Skywalker, destroying his own dwelling with the Force in the process. Believing his uncle dead, Solo left the ruins of his room, confused and consumed with despair and rage at the betrayal. Led by his fear and anger, Solo destroyed the temple and its students[[Star Wars: Age of Resistance – The Official Collector's Edition|''Star Wars: Age of Resistance'' – The Official Collector's Edition]] with a [[Destruction of the Jedi Temple|powerful lightning storm from the sky]] that set the temple ablaze and killed the Jedi inside. ===First Order-Resistance War=== Seeking revenge on his former master and uncle after the [[Battle of Crait]], [[Supreme Leader]] Kylo Ren briefly visited the ruins of the Jedi temple and ordered [[General]] [[Armitage Hux|Hux]] to attack the location with an [[orbital bombardment]].{{StoryCite|story=See You Around, Kid|book=Star Wars (2020) 25}} ==Inhabitants== Ossus was home to a [[human]] population and, according to legend, a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[Ysanna]] species, a tribal group of [[near-human]]s with a high percentage of Force-sensitivity among them. Ysanna wore tribal masks and depended on the native kirruk, residing in the [[nitrogen]]-rich valleys near the [[Eocho Mountains]]. [[Farm]]ing was their main source of [[Foodstuff|food]], though [[hunting]] with [[concussion bow]]s became increasingly useful. It was also the [[homeworld]] of [[Veris Hydan]], a scholar of Jedi and Sith lore who served as advisor to [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] during the [[Imperial Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ==Locations== ===Knossa=== {{Main|Knossa}} One of the few cities on Ossus named within the Qel-Droma Epics, Knossa was built from stone and [[bronzium]], and its squat domes were located high in the western [[Eocho Mountains]]. Knossa supposedly consisted of the [[Eye of Ashlanae]], a powerful Force [[vergence]] on one of its peaks, and [[Knossa Spaceport]], which resembled a sprawling promenade wrapped around [[Agorn Mountain]], which was originally built to support [[pilgrim]]s visiting the nearby Eye of Ashlanae. ===Great Jedi Library=== {{Main|Great Jedi Library}} [[File:Lost_Library_NoP.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Chamber of Antiquities during the Imperial Era.]] According to the Epics, Odan-Urr designed and oversaw the construction of the Great Jedi Library atop the Ooroo Canyon on Ossus to honor a promise to his Master Ooroo. The main public area of the Great Library's collections was known as the [[Hall of Knowledge]], open to the public and encompassing chambers on multiple levels and functions. Containing ancient [[Star map|star charts]] and Jedi texts, philosophical text, galactic histories for thousands of worlds, the Hall of Knowledge was sprawling and exhaustive. In the Chamber of Antiquities, Odan-Urr catalogued and studied ancient artifacts, as well as translated and digitized [[writing]]s, and kept the most treasured and dangerous items in the entire library. The library stood for nearly a [[Millennium|thousand]] years as the physical embodiment of Jedi dedication to knowledge. It required several days' of pilgrimage to reach Ooroo Canyon, where the library was located, far from Knossa and [[Ossus City]]. The Great Library was devastated during the Cron Supernova and by the Imperial Era, its ruins were the only remains of what was once a palatial facility. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Knossa.jpg|thumb|left|260px|Ossus as it first appeared in ''Tales of the Jedi'']] Ossus was first [[canon]]ically mentioned in the short story "[[The End of History]]" by [[Alexander Freed]], which was published in [[Star Wars Insider 154|issue 154]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine on [[December 9]], [[2014]].{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/154|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #154}} In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] was first mentioned in the [[Dark Empire endnotes|endnotes]] essay for the [[Dark Empire 4|fourth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which was written by [[Tom Veitch]],[[Dark Empire endnotes|''Dark Empire'' endnotes]] and first appeared in the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 1|first issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']] story arc [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising|''The Freedon Nadd Uprising'']], which was written by Veitch, illustrated by [[Tony Akins]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[August 2]], [[1994]].[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 1]] In the [[2015]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], a forested planet appears in a [[Force vision|vision]] to the character [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] and is established to be the location of Luke Skywalker's Jedi Temple, but the planet itself goes unnamed in the film and would remain unidentified for several years.{{Film|VII}} This planet appeared again in the [[Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger|sixth episode]] of the [[2022]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'', once again unnamed in dialogue. According to [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Pablo Hidalgo]], however, the episode's script, written by [[Jon Favreau]] and [[Dave Filoni]], settled on the idea that the forested planet and Ossus were one and the same.{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1545192580463308801|Pablo Hidalgo|quote=it was the Book of Boba Fett script that settled on that name. But Shadows of the Sith got the honors of surfacing it in print.|archivedate=20220708011943}} This decision would be further disseminated in the 2022 novel ''[[Shadow of the Sith]]'' by [[Adam Christopher]], the first source to call the planet Ossus in print. The [[2019]] reference book ''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' established Ossus as the homeworld of Veris Hydan. The author [[Adam Bray]] wanted to make a meaningful ''Star Wars'' Legends connection. He also noted the irony of an Imperial Advisor being born on the planet that once housed the Great Jedi Library, a repository of all Jedi knowledge.{{Twitter|authoradambray|1316959074005716992|[[Adam Bray]]|quote=I love creating connections in Star Wars canon to meaningful Expanded Universe history. Thus in Ultimate Star Wars I designated the homeworld of Veris Hydan as Ossus.
